FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
NOT_FOUND: This record is unavailable or does not belong to your account.
POLICY_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: The shop must approve the business terms before activating this service. Please contact staff.
SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again. Check your transaction history before retrying a payment or order.
NETWORK_ERROR: The shop is unreachable. Check your connection and try again.
PRICE_CHANGED: The price changed. Review and confirm the latest quote.
STOCK_CHANGED: Available stock changed. Reload before recording an inventory correction.
RESERVATION_PAYMENT_INVALID: Verify a payment of at least 50% initially. Additional payments cannot exceed the remaining balance.
PAYMENT_REFERENCE_REUSED: This transaction reference is already assigned to another operation. Check the payment history.
RESERVATION_INACTIVE: This hold cannot accept the requested operation. Review its current status and deadline.
BENEFIT_CONFLICT: Choose one benefit: sale prices, a promotion code or your member tier.
REWARD_UNAVAILABLE: This reward is already reserved or used.
PARTNER_PHOTO_CONSENT: Confirm that these merchandise photos may be shown publicly.
PARTNER_PHOTOS_INVALID: Use owned merchandise photos. A preowned collectible needs three distinct actual views and quantity one.
PARTNER_CONDITION_REQUIRED: Confirm the exact identity and complete condition disclosure.
PARTNER_LISTING_INVALID: Check model identity, price, quantity, category, condition and dispatch time.
PARTNER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The reviewed seller listing or total-value limit has been exceeded.
PARTNER_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: An active verified seller account is required.
PARTNER_STATE_CHANGED: The listing changed. Refresh inventory and review its current version.
PARTNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Verify actual photos and the complete condition disclosure separately.
PARTNER_LISTING_REQUIRED: Use the dedicated seller listing and moderation workflow.
PARTNER_GUARANTEE_HELD: Resolve the accepted guarantee before changing the merchandise.
PARTNER_GUARANTEE_TRANSFER: Verify the exact guarantee amount, actual bank reference and current history.
PARTNER_GUARANTEE_OBLIGATIONS: Sale or dispute obligations require reconciliation before a refund.
PARTNER_GUARANTEE_BANK: Verify the unchanged accepted refund account.
AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is unavailable. Try again later.
PARTNER_BANK_REQUIRED: Provide the new payout account and private verification photographs.
PARTNER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Confirm your account request before submitting.
PARTNER_OBLIGATIONS_OPEN: Resolve accepted guarantees and existing seller sales before changing the bank or closing the account.
ADDRESS_INVALID: Check the delivery address fields and label.
ADDRESS_CHANGED: The saved address changed. Refresh before editing or removing it.
ADDRESS_LIMIT: You can save up to 20 addresses.
RESTOCK_AVAILABLE: This model is already available. Check the current listing.
RESTOCK_LIMIT: You can save up to 100 stock alerts.
UNIQUE_ITEM_INTAKE_REQUIRED: Each preowned model needs its own inspected intake record. Stock cannot be replenished through a bulk receipt.
MARKETPLACE_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED: Partner checkout is not available until seller shipping and payment terms are ready.
